topic: Release notes and data access restrictions
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the content and distribution of upcoming release notes for firmware and core services. It was decided that while charts should be included in presentations, general release notes should remove specific names (like AFA) and sensor details to maintain confidentiality.

Regarding data access, several issues were identified: public Confluence pages allowed editing by everyone, and users had trouble accessing the release note links via email. Actions were taken to restrict access to various spaces (e.g., Ocean space restricted to prevent anonymous viewing). The team agreed that long-term access management for different company spaces needs further discussion.
decisions: Release notes should remove specific names and sensor details to maintain confidentiality.
The current version link was corrected from staging-mops.allunite.com/ to mods.allunite.com, and the new version is staging-analytics.allunite.com.
Access to Confluence spaces needs restriction to prevent unauthorized editing.
action_items: The team will discuss long-term access management for company spaces in a future meeting (Monday).
Release notes need to be sent to Baltic, Germany, and Belgium contacts who placed orders.
AFA mentions must be removed from the JCDecaux release materials.
